text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Needs correction. You should swim through 
the 'Azure Sky' by day, and the 
'Starfield' by night."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Swimming reverses the "vector." It smooths 
away the craters in your "heart."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe went swimming today too. 
That's why there is a "pulsar." ...It is 
『recommended』.
